Comparison of Marine Ecosystems of Haizhou Bay and Lvsi
Fishing Ground in China Based on the Ecopath Model
Shike Gao 1, Ze Chen 1, Yanan Lu 1, Zhen Li 1, Shuo Zhang 1,* and Wenwen Yu 2,*
1 College of Marine Sciences, Shanghai Ocean University, Shanghai 201306, China;
d200200049@st.shou.edu.cn (S.G.); m190200613@st.shou.edu.cn (Z.C.); 1921205@st.shou.edu.cn (Y.L.);

2 Jiangsu Research Institute of Marine Fisheries, Nantong 226007, China
* Correspondence: s-zhang@shou.edu.cn (S.Z.); jshyyww@163.com (W.Y.)

conservation and recovery have become increasingly important for the management and sustainable
development of ﬁshery resources. We construct two Ecopath models to describe and compare the
